The demon was dispatched by Krishna 's evil uncle Kamsa , who was destined to die at Krishna 's hands . The tale of the slaying of Keshi is told in the Hindu scriptures of Bhagavata Purana , Vishnu Purana and Harivamsa . Krishna is often praised as Keshava - the slayer of Keshi - in scriptures . Theories suggested about Keshi 's origins range from his being a demon of childhood diseases to the story 's being inspired by the Greek Herculean labour of slaying the horses of Diomedes .
